metadata.name: Redhair Quality — Setup and updater
metadata.description: One customizable template for new setups and updates. Choose which sections to apply. Skip Services to preserve your existing accounts. Usenet add-ons are optional and off by default. Includes four live formatter previews.
metadata.author: Local adaptation

inputs.name: Customize before applying
inputs.description: For a new setup, select your services. For updates that should keep existing accounts, use Skip on the Services step: service selection is separate from the switches below. Enable only the sections you want to replace; switch off the rest. For an SEL-only update, leave only SEL and regex on. Proxy settings and user variants are always preserved. Usenet add-ons and Meteor Usenet search are off by default.

inputs.name: Quality and ranking
inputs.description: Choose the quality settings to replace.

inputs.name: Replace SEL and regex
inputs.description: Default: synced 2160p Remux + Anime Remux 1080p, supplied language scoring and 9 overrides. Replaces custom SEL/regex rules too. Off preserves your settings.

inputs.name: Replace Basic filters
inputs.description: Default: hide uncached streams, 240p/144p, CAM/SCR/TS/TC and 3D; prefer 2160p/1080p. Digital-release filtering on. Off preserves your settings.

inputs.name: Replace Sorting
inputs.description: Default: cached first; library → resolution → quality → SEL score. Cached anime: SeaDex → SEL score. Off preserves your settings.

inputs.name: Replace Result, size and bitrate limits
inputs.description: Default: simultaneous caps of 3/service, 3/resolution and 4/quality; global size 50 MB–100 GB. SEL may impose further limits. Off preserves your settings.

inputs.name: Replace Metadata matching and SeaDex
inputs.description: Default: SeaDex on, exact movie/series titles, strict movie years and season/episode matching. Off preserves your settings.

inputs.name: Replace Deduplication
inputs.description: Default: filename/info-hash duplicates per service; prefer library results; merging on. Off preserves your settings.

inputs.name: Add-ons and connections
inputs.description: Select your sources here; optional connection settings are below.

inputs.name: Replace Add-ons, catalogs and fetching
inputs.description: Default: 9 non-Usenet sources. Replaces sources, catalogs and colors; dynamic fetching and groups off. Off preserves your settings.

inputs.name: Add-ons to include
inputs.description: Default: 9 non-Usenet sources, listed first. Optional sources follow; Usenet entries are labeled and unchecked. Selected sources replace your add-on list. Connection details are entered on Credentials.

inputs.name: Advanced add-on settings
inputs.description: Optional: timeout, service assignments and Meteor Usenet search.

subOptions.name: Enable Meteor Usenet search
subOptions.description: Off by default: Meteor searches without its Usenet option. Enable only if you want Usenet results and have a compatible service. Other Usenet add-ons must be explicitly selected above.

subOptions.name: Add-on service assignments
subOptions.description: Use my enabled services (default): each add-on uses your enabled accounts that it supports. Redhair assignments (optional): Store/Meteor → TorBox; Library, Althub, U-Crawler, N-Central, T-Rasa and D-Slug → AIOStreams; Indexarr → NZBDAV. Other add-ons have no explicit service restriction. Redhair’s Library/Store catalog customizations apply only in Redhair mode. This controls add-on routing, not your saved accounts.

options.label: Use my enabled services (recommended for new setup)

subOptions.name: Add-on timeout
subOptions.description: Redhair defaults: Debridio waits up to 4 seconds; every other bundled add-on waits up to 5 seconds. The 10 / 20 / 30 second choices give every selected add-on that same timeout. Longer waits can include slower sources but may delay results. This does not change playback timeouts.

inputs.name: Appearance
inputs.description: Choose a style to see its preview immediately.

inputs.name: Replace Formatter
inputs.description: Default: Redhair stream layout, or choose an alternative below. Does not change posters. Off preserves your settings.

inputs.name: Replace Poster settings
inputs.description: Default: RPDB poster service. Does not change the stream formatter. Off preserves your settings.

inputs.name: Formatter style
inputs.description: Preview updates when you select a style. Redhair (default): multi-line name with source, resolution, score and size. Jeormatter: title as the name, compact technical details below. Alt: quality as the name, title below. Filename: Jeormatter plus the complete filename. All use Redhair’s Best/Tier scoring.

inputs.name: Playback and diagnostics
inputs.description: Choose the playback and diagnostic settings to replace.

inputs.name: Replace Playback, downloads and failover
inputs.description: Default: first Usenet stream preloaded, owned checks on, next-episode precache/cache-and-play off; failover up to 5 attempts; TorBox wrapping on. Off preserves your settings.

inputs.name: Replace Statistics and errors
inputs.description: Default: add-on/filter/timing statistics at the bottom; no resource errors hidden. Off preserves your settings.

inputs.name: Review before applying
inputs.description: Enabled sections replace their matching settings; disabled sections stay unchanged. On Review, use “See exactly what changes” to compare with your current configuration before applying. [Full default settings](https://github.com/Jeor/aiored/blob/main/DEFAULTS.md).

__value.expression: /*Bitrate Filter*/((queryType == 'anime.series') or (queryType == 'anime.movie')or ('Animation' in genres)) ? [] : merge(bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '2160p'), 'Bluray REMUX'), 1, '25Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '2160p'), 'Bluray'), 1, '13.6Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '2160p'), 'WEB-DL', 'WEBRip'), 1, '4.6Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '2160p'), 'HDTV'), 1, '11.33Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '1080p'), 'Bluray REMUX'), 1, '13.6Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '1080p'), 'Bluray'), 1, '6.77Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '1080p'), 'WEB-DL', 'WEBRip'), 1, '1.67Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '1080p'), 'HDTV'), 1, '4.51Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '720p'), 'Bluray'), 1, '3.43Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '720p'), 'WEB-DL', 'WEBRip'), 1, '1.67Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '720p'), 'HDTV'), 1, '2.28Mbps'))
/*ongoing Season Pack*/((queryType=='series' or queryType=='anime.series') and ongoingSeason and (daysSinceLastAired <-1 or daysUntilNextEpisode>=0))?seasonPack(streams,'onlySeasons'):[]
/*#Radarr*/ /*Not Original or English or Tamil*/ queryType=='movie' ? negate(merge(language(streams, "Original"), language(streams, "English"), language(streams, "Tamil")), streams) : []
/*#Sonarr*/ /*Not Original or English or Tamil*/ queryType=='series' ? negate(merge(language(streams, "Original"), language(streams, "English"), language(streams, "Tamil")), streams) : []
/*#Radarr*/ /*Not Original or English*/ queryType=='movie' ? negate(merge(language(streams, "Original"), language(streams, "English")), streams) : []
/*#Sonarr*/ /*Not Original or English*/ queryType=='series' ? negate(merge(language(streams, "Original"), language(streams, "English")), streams) : []

__value.condition: (queryType=='anime.series')?((count(seadex(cached(totalStreams),'best'))>=1 and count(totalStreams)>=5) or (totalTimeTaken>=5000 and (count(regexMatched(cached(totalStreams),'Anime BD T1','Anime Web T1'))>=4 or count(resolution(cached(totalStreams),'1080p'))>=12)) or totalTimeTaken>=7000) : (queryType=='anime.movie' or (queryType == 'anime.series' or queryType == 'anime.movie'))?((count(seadex(cached(totalStreams),'best'))>=1 and count(totalStreams)>=5) or (totalTimeTaken>=5000 and (count(regexMatched(cached(totalStreams),'Anime BD T1'))>=3 or count(resolution(cached(totalStreams),'2160p'))>=6)) or totalTimeTaken>=7000) : (queryType=='movie')?((count(totalStreams)>=5 and ('N-Central' in queriedAddons or 'Althub' in queriedAddons or 'U-Crawler' in queriedAddons) and (count(type(totalStreams,'usenet','debrid'))>=1 or count(regexMatched(cached(totalStreams),'Remux T1','Bluray T1'))>=2 or count(resolution(cached(totalStreams),'2160p'))>=8)) or (count(totalStreams)>=20 and ('Debridio' in queriedAddons or 'Torz' in queriedAddons or 'Torrentio' in queriedAddons) and count(regexMatched(cached(totalStreams),'Remux T1','Bluray T1'))>=5) or totalTimeTaken>=7000) : ((count(totalStreams)>=5 and ('N-Central' in queriedAddons or 'Althub' in queriedAddons or 'U-Crawler' in queriedAddons) and (count(type(totalStreams,'usenet','debrid'))>=1 or count(regexMatched(cached(totalStreams),'Web T1','Remux T1'))>=2 or count(resolution(cached(totalStreams),'2160p','1080p'))>=15)) or totalTimeTaken>=7000)
